requirement_summary: Ingest Noraxon MR4 single CSV with metadata header and time-series table
Ingest Noraxon MR4 separated export with info.csv and independent signal files
Read per-signal metadata: type/name/begin_time/frequency/count/units when present
Do not assume all signals in one record share sampling rate
Validate monotonic time and metadata count versus rows when possible
Distinguish V/uV; any conversion must have provenance
Raw layer preserves missing values; no automatic interpolation
Every source file has checksum/hash and source identifier
Support Vicon stacked-section parser for approved use cases
Do not hard-code X/Y/Z to anatomical planes without verified convention
Create canonical Session ID without direct patient identifier
Preserve device/software version, measurement time, sampling, signal name, units, record name when available
Support muscle/side/protocol/task/load-speed/clinical context when provided
Missing mandatory metadata causes warning/fail per policy; never guessed
Versioned vendor signal name to canonical muscle/channel ontology
Store de-identification and consent/governance metadata when available
Reproducibility: same input + config/version yields same output within defined tolerance
Traceability: source + processing/config + version for outputs
Data integrity: raw immutable; checksum validation; processed does not overwrite raw
Privacy: do not expose/log unnecessary identifiers; real data follows approved policy
Version data schemas/configs/rules/models
Failure safety: parser/QC/model error fails closed and cannot create final-looking result
Parser ingests MR4 single + separated samples and creates canonical session without losing raw
Every signal has sampling/unit/provenance or is explicitly flagged missing
Raw data is immutable and checksum is verifiable
